text:
maria: Quick follow-up from last night's incident — we need targeted tests to catch the prompt-dependent token explosion pattern. Owners + ETA?
kevin: Agree. Proposed items: prompt-set regression (10 seeds), RPS burst load test with KV warmup, and a chaos drill for partition/OOM. Who wants which?
jess: I can take prompt-set regression and own the prompt files + harness. Will add to evals repo. ETA EOW.
maria: Thanks. Can you make the harness run against hosted and dedicated variants? Example command:
```
python evals/run_prompts.py --targets=redwood-v1,dedicated-v1 --cases=prompts/incidents/*.json
```
jess: Yup. I'll include a pass/fail rule that flags token growth > 2x baseline and generation length cap.
rohan: I'll own the load tests. Plan: extend the k6 script to simulate KV cold->hot transitions and a 10s ramp to 500 RPS. Threshold: 95th pct latency < 300ms. ETA next Wed.
kevin: I can own chaos drills and canary fallback checks. Will add a test that simulates a GPU OOM and verifies fallback to quantized variant within 10s. Need telemetry events to be emitted.
maria: Who will add the eval alert in Grafana/Prometheus? Want automated regression alert for the incident prompt set.
jess: I can add an alert rule that exports `eval_prompt_failure_rate` and a dashboard panel. Do we want paging on regressions?
maria: Page P0 if failure_rate > 5% for 2 consecutive runs. First responder: eng-ml oncall, then escalate to eng-sre.
kevin: I'll tie action items to PM-432 and add links in the eval PRs.
rohan: Observed pattern: errors only when sequences contained repeated stop tokens. Need a synthetic test case for that.
jess: Adding `prompts/incidents/repeat-stop.json` and sample outputs for distribution comparison.
ci-bot: New PR by jess: https://git.redwood/evals/pulls/128 — eval harness + alert stub
maria: Timeline recap: jess (prompt regress) EOW; rohan (load tests) next Wed; kevin (chaos + telemetry) in 2w; alerts tied by jess and verified in CI. Owners update PM-432 in 48h with progress. Any blockers?
rohan: Need a dedicated GPU for load test isolation — @infra-team can we reserve one?
kevin: Need read access to fallback logs/buckets for verification — eng-sre, can you grant `kevin` read?
eng-sre-bot: Access request filed ACC-778, ETA 1 business day
maria: Also scheduling a 30min drill next Fri 10am to run chaos script end-to-end with oncall. I'll send a calendar invite.
jess: :thumbsup:
kevin: lgtm
rohan: thanks
